answer_sw: Bendi ya pili ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 9 kwenye sehemu inayozidi TZS 270,000.
answer_en: The second PAYE band in Tanzania is 9% on the excess over TZS 270,000.
guards_against: THE TRUE POSITIVE THE GATE EXISTS FOR. A compact, unnegated assertion of band 2 at 9% when the locked rate is 8%. If the 2026-10-08 narrowings ever stop this flagging, they have been widened too far and the gate is decoration.

answer_sw: Bendi tano za PAYE Tanzania 2025/2026: (1) TZS 0 hadi 270,000: kiwango 0%; (2) TZS 270,001 hadi 520,000: kiwango 8% (si 9%); (3) TZS 520,001 hadi 760,000: kiwango 20%; (4) TZS 760,001 hadi 1,000,000: kiwango 25%; (5) Zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000: kiwango 30%.
guards_against: b008_paye_adv_002 VERBATIM. The row this gate flagged, which was then QUARANTINED on that basis and restored on 2026-10-08 as an over-removal. It states 8% and explicitly denies 9%, in BOTH languages. Measured on the real matcher, `paye.*band.*9%` spanned 604 characters from answer_sw into answer_en and landed on the `9%` inside the English '(not 9%)'. Both narrowings are needed: the span cap and the backward negation window.

answer_sw: UWONGO — bendi ya pili ya PAYE ni asilimia 8, si 9. Bendi zote tano za PAYE kwa kipindi cha 2025/2026: Bendi 1: TZS 0-270,000 = 0%; Bendi 2: TZS 270,001-520,000 = 8%; Bendi 3: TZS 520,001-760,000 = 20%.
answer_en: FALSE — the second PAYE band is 8%, not 9%. All five PAYE bands for 2025/2026: Band 1: TZS 0-270,000 = 0%; Band 2: TZS 270,001-520,000 = 8%; Band 3: TZS 520,001-760,000 = 20%.
guards_against: b008_paye_adv_001 VERBATIM — the instance that was LIVE AT HEAD carrying this false positive while four of its siblings had been quarantined for it. A row that opens by calling the wrong value FALSE and is flagged for containing it.

answer_sw: Mfumo wa PAYE Tanzania una bendi ya kiwango cha sifuri kwa TZS 270,000 za kwanza za mapato ya kila mwezi — hii ndiyo ruhusa ya mapato yasiyotozwa kodi iliyojengwa ndani ya mfumo. Hakuna punguzo la kibinafsi tofauti la TZS 26,000 kwa mwezi linalotakiwa kukatwa kutoka PAYE iliyohesabiwa.
answer_en: Tanzania's PAYE system has a zero-rate band on the first TZS 270,000 of monthly income — that is the tax-free allowance, built into the system. There is NO separate personal relief of TZS 26,000 per month to be deducted from computed PAYE.
guards_against: b008_paye_adv_005 VERBATIM, found wrongly removed on 2026-10-08. It says exactly what CLAUDE.md s.11 says is correct ('No separate personal relief deduction in Tanzania. The 0% Band 1 IS the effective tax-free threshold') and was quarantined for ASSERTING the phantom relief.

answer_sw: Punguzo la kibinafsi ni TZS 26,000 kwa mwezi (TZS 312,000 kwa mwaka). Baada ya kuhesabu PAYE, unatoa TZS 26,000 kutoka kwenye jumla.
answer_en: The personal relief is TZS 26,000 per month (TZS 312,000 per year). After computing PAYE, you deduct TZS 26,000 from the total.
guards_against: THE TRUE POSITIVE for the relief class, taken from the quarantine record. A plain unnegated assertion of a relief that does not exist. The lfp_04/lfp_05 pair is the whole point: same figure, opposite polarity, and only one is a defect.

answer_sw: Ada za mkurugenzi zinatoza WHT ya asilimia 15 kwa wakazi NA wasio wakazi — kiwango ni sawa kwa wote. Hii ni tofauti na ada za usimamizi ambapo wakazi (5%) na wasio wakazi (15%) wana viwango tofauti.
answer_en: Director fees attract 15% WHT for residents AND non-residents — the rate is the same for both. This is unlike management fees, where residents (5%) and non-residents (15%) have different rates.
guards_against: tier1a_wht_deep_035 VERBATIM. THE SUBSTRING COLLISION: the pattern's bare `rent` matched inside the ordinary English word 'diffe-RENT', on the text 'non-residents (15%) have different'. The row is about DIRECTOR FEES and says nothing about rent; both of its claims are correct. Fixed by word-bounding \brent\b in locked_facts.json. Same class as the three OOC substring collisions CLAUDE.md records.

answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio kwenye pango kwa wasio wakazi ni asilimia 15.
answer_en: Withholding tax on rent for non-residents is 15%.
guards_against: THE TRUE POSITIVE for rent WHT. Cap.332 First Schedule para 4(b)(ii) gives the non-resident limb the same TEN percent, and TRA's own table reads 10%|10%. Word-bounding \brent\b must NOT cost this match -- a narrowing that deletes its own true positive is the deleting-direction failure.

answer_sw: Kama una wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, biashara yako lazima isajiliwe na OSHA.
answer_en: If you have 10 or more employees your workplace must register with OSHA.
guards_against: A TRUE POSITIVE THAT SURVIVED BOTH NARROWINGS AND MUST KEEP SURVIVING. It gives OSHA registration a 10-employee threshold, which is SDL's threshold, not OSHA's -- OSHA registration has no headcount floor. Compact and unnegated, so neither the span cap nor the polarity window touches it. Included because a sweep that only keeps probes it expects to clear cannot show that a narrowing left the gate working (R17: write the probes that should come back CLEAN, and the ones that must still FLAG).
